descriptionChirho: Sour or fermented wine used as a condiment or drink, attested in both literal and simile contexts (Prov 10:26 'like vinegar to the teeth'). Multilingual evidence is uniform: Spanish 'vinagre,' Arabic خلّ (khall), Korean 식초/초, Hindi सिरका (sirka), Swahili 'siki.' All three clusters represent the same substance in different grammatical frames — bare noun, construct state with 'of,' and prepositional 'in the vinegar' — none indicating a distinct semantic sense.
